title: Vendor panel (Seller Center): catalogue, orders and onboarding — browser test report
summary: Playwright browser test of the Seller Center catalogue and order side on data created by the run: every page of the product-store sidebar (23 of 23, plus Notifications and Sign-in history), listings on two variants of one product (validation, draft, review, admin approval, price, images and alt text, stock ledger, pause/resume), product and change requests, an order confirmed through to shipped with packing slip, an order cancelled, a return approved, received, inspected and refunded, review replies and answers, tenant isolation, the /join?ref= application with the referral recorded, approval and first sign-in, and the Seller Agreement gate with signing. Re-run of 2026-11-19 after the big development catalogue (5,000 products, about 30,000 offers and 60 sellers per country, new home and category pages, mega menu): the full Playwright suite ran on a fresh production build with E2eSeeder records; 15 of 15 flows passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
environment: API + panels http://localhost:8000; Seller Center host partner.nawy.test:8000 (Chromium host-resolver-rules)
Laravel dev DB (uae; Qatar for the Seller Agreement gate), MAIL_MAILER=log, NAWY_PAYMENTS_DRIVER=fake
Playwright project 'areas', Desktop Chrome, 2 workers, E2E_SKIP_SEED=1, --no-deps

e2e-ven-<run>@nawy.test — store e2e-ven-<run>, created by support/setup.php

issues.description: The vendor area's setup (e2e/specs/areas/vendor/support/setup.php) keeps an AED 80 seller-fulfilled offer (E2E-VEN-ORD) on the same product as the customer specs. The lowest price wins the buy box, so the product page, cart and orders of the customer / checkout / lifecycle specs got that offer instead of the FBN AED 95 one (CHK-01, WEB-05, ORD-02 failed).
issues.fix: The order listing is priced AED 135 (above the AED 95 FBN and AED 120 seller offers) and repriced on every run; the dev listing was updated.

issues.description: After inspecting a return, the flash said "Inspection saved. Refund 80.0000." — the raw 4-decimal storage value with no currency.
issues.fix: ManagesReturns::inspect formats the amount with MoneyFormatter ("Refund AED 80.00."). Pest: ReturnsAndRefundsTest 'lets the seller review and inspect only their own returns'.

issues.description: An Orders member (products: view only) saw 'Add a product' and could open the create form, only to get a 403 on submit. Same for coupon, campaign and inbound-plan create pages.
issues.fix: tenant.can:{panel},{group},write for form-only GET pages (products/create, coupons/create & edit, campaigns/create, inventory/inbound/create, marketplace/ads/create); create buttons hidden without write access. Pest: QaWave1TenantPermissionsTest 'a read-only member cannot open the forms for changes…'.

issues.description: A read-only member still sees the price/stock/image forms on a listing page (the server refuses the change with 403).
A completed return keeps an empty 'Actions' card.

notes: Re-run of 2026-11-19: results, steps and screenshots are from the full Playwright run after the big catalogue (servers on a fresh production build). Issues BR-xx were found and fixed in this run; older issues are kept for reference.

Dev-only: uploaded images are served from APP_URL (http://localhost:8000/storage/…) while the panel CSP allows img-src 'self' https:, so product images do not render on partner.nawy.test:8000 in dev. On the https production hosts they load; the specs drop exactly that console line (dropDevImageCsp).

Panel sign-in is rate-limited per IP (30/min) and per account (30/hour); every agent's browser is 127.0.0.1, so the specs keep one e2e-seller session per worker in the OS temp dir (the shared e2e/.auth files are never rewritten) and serialise sign-ins of one email (two parallel 2FA logins read each other's mail code).
Panel language is saved on the user (preferred_locale), so the Arabic test runs as the run's own store owner, never the shared e2e seller.

Test data per run (support/setup.php, test values only): two new catalogue variants and an FBN variant of the first active product, sub-orders on the e2e store's own variant E2E-VEN-ORD (never listing 19 or the seeded e2e orders), a COD cash record for the delivered ones, a published review and an approved question, a return, a new uae store, a Qatar store, a Seller Agreement template published for Qatar only, a test ad slot (placement e2e_test, never requested by the storefront) and an 'E2E vendor flash sale' open for submissions.

The warehouse receiving of the inbound plan (arrive → receive 6 → finish) is a warehouse-staff step and was run through the InboundShipments service in tinker, so the removal flow had units to remove.

Order labels: the seller moved the COD order to Shipped (confirmed → processing → packed → shipped). No carrier shipment is allocated by that path, so the parcel label button did not show; the invoice PDF is only issued once the order is invoiced (after delivery for COD). Packing slip HTML was checked. Carrier label / delivery are covered in the order-lifecycle report.
FBN fees: the fee preview shows 0 per unit (owner decision).
Coupon limits D10 checked on a brand-new store: 91% refused, an end date more than 365 days away refused, the 20th live coupon accepted and the 21st refused (coupons 2–19 were copies made in tinker).
